thread:
Maria (Design): quick review please — compact relevance table iteration uploaded to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — main changes: density toggle, collapsed row affordance, new sort icon, export modal copy. wanna ship asap for next sprint :eyes:
Charlie (PM): skimmed — looks good. question: default sort should stay 'relevance desc' or 'last updated'? leaning relevance for now.
Anya (Eng): for performance we should lazy-render vector previews when scrolled into view. otherwise big pages kill the client. also keyboard focus order needs attention after toggling density.
Raj (A11y): flagged a couple screen reader issues — export modal "Export rows" is ambiguous. suggest "Download selected vectors as CSV" and announce number of rows. also density toggle needs aria-pressed and an accessible label.
Lee (Product): +1 to the explicit download copy. also the CTA contrast on the export button looks sub-threshold on the gray bg — need color tweak. pinging design-bot for contrast test.
design-bot: contrast analyzer — primary CTA (hex #0066CC) on bg #F3F4F6 fails AA small text, passes large. Recommend #005BB5 or increase weight.
Maria (Design): thanks — will update copy and CTA color. for keyboard: proposal is tab order: checkbox -> row -> actions -> preview toggle. is that ok?
Anya (Eng): that's fine. but keep a single escape target: when preview expands, focus should move into the preview and ESC should collapse and return focus to preview toggle.
Raj (A11y): add the following ARIA snippet for the preview toggle so screen readers announce state:
```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-controls="vector-preview-123" aria-label="Show vector preview for row 123">🛈</button>
```
and in the preview region: `role="region" aria-live="polite" aria-labelledby="preview-heading-123"`
Maria (Design): perfect. I'll push a copy update: change "Export" -> "Download vectors (CSV)" and modal helper text: "Only the visible columns will be exported. Selected filters apply."
Charlie (PM): tiny product ask — can we surface an inline count next to the density toggle like "Compact • 42 rows" so users know page density?
Lee (Product): yes that helps set expectations. if we show row count we should also include an N of selected when filter applied.
Anya (Eng): pragmatic note — computing selected count server-side is cheap, but for very large result sets we'll show "10k+" shorthand. implement fallback.
Maria (Design): ok will mock both states (exact count / 10k+). putting all changes in Figma now, will loop back once updated. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
Raj (A11y): quick checklist for follow-up: 1) export modal copy update 2) aria-pressed & labels on density toggle 3) focus management for preview 4) announce row counts 5) CTA contrast fix. I'll run a quick screen-reader pass after design push.
Charlie (PM): solid. target to merge UI changes by Thu so eng can pick up for next sprint.
Maria (Design): noted — will aim for Wed evening upload. closing thread once Figma updated.
